# PTCGTools

> Free multitool web app for Pokémon TCG (Trading Card Game) players: a Monte Carlo mulligan / draw-odds calculator and a deckbuilder with multi-filter card search. Supports Pokémon TCG Live and Limitless deck list import.

PTCGTools helps Pokémon TCG players analyze and build decks using real simulation data instead of simplified math. The mulligan & draw odds calculator runs thousands of brute-force Monte Carlo simulations against an actual deck list to estimate mulligan probability and deck consistency. The site is bilingual (English / Spanish), served from the same URLs.

## Tools

- [Mulligan & Draw Odds Calculator](https://ptcg-tools.vercel.app/calc): Monte Carlo simulation-based calculator for opening hand and mulligan probability, and the odds of drawing a specific card by a given turn. Imports deck lists from TCG Live and Limitless formats.
- [Deckbuilder](https://ptcg-tools.vercel.app/decks): Deck builder with multi-filter card search for constructing and editing Pokémon TCG deck lists.

## Notes

- Key terms: Pokémon TCG, mulligan calculator, TCG odds calculator, Pokémon TCG draw calculator, deckbuilder, TCG Live, Limitless, Monte Carlo simulation.
- Publisher: Jorge Colomer Albertos ([GitHub](https://github.com/jorgelol20)).
- The `/results` route renders per-simulation output pages and is intentionally left out of this file — it isn't meant to be indexed or crawled.
